abstract: This paper examines the impact of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through. Theoretically, we demonstrate that greater importer dispersion – characterized by larger variations in import size across importers – leads to higher demand elasticity and lower exporter markups, thereby resulting in greater exchange rate pass‐through. Using transaction‐level customs data from Colombia, we provide robust empirical evidence supporting this prediction. The quantitative effect of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through is significant: the importer dispersion channel is at least as important as the traditional exporter heterogeneity channel. Our results are robust to various empirical specifications and become even stronger in the context of the dominant currency paradigm.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了进口商分散度对汇率传递的影响。理论上，我们证明更大的进口商分散度——表现为各进口商进口规模差异更大——会导致更高的需求弹性和更低的出口商加成定价，从而产生更强的汇率传递效应。利用哥伦比亚交易层面的海关数据，我们提供了支持这一预测的稳健实证证据。进口商分散度对汇率传递的量化影响显著：该渠道的重要性至少与传统出口商异质性渠道相当。我们的结论在多种实证设定下保持稳健，且在主导货币范式背景下更为显著。

abstract: This study evaluates the impact of the Pilot Free Trade Zones (PFTZs) on the carbon emissions of enterprises located within the zones. By manually identifying PFTZs’ boundaries and employing a spatial regression discontinuity (SRD) design, we find that the establishment of the PFTZs significantly reduces the carbon emission intensity of enterprises within the zones. This conclusion remains valid across a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that the PFTZs drives emission reductions by intensifying market competition, stimulating green technology innovation, and alleviating financing constraints. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses indicate that these effects are more pronounced in heavily polluting industries, technology-intensive enterprises, non-state-owned enterprises, and areas with a larger scale of construction. This study provides a vital theoretical basis for China’s green and high-quality development strategies in the current context of carbon reduction.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了自由贸易试验区（PFTZs）对区内企业碳排放的影响。通过手动识别自贸区边界并采用空间断点回归（SRD）设计，我们发现自贸区的设立显著降低了区内企业的碳排放强度。该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，自贸区通过加剧市场竞争、激发绿色技术创新以及缓解融资约束来推动减排。此外，异质性分析显示，这些效应在重污染行业、技术密集型企业、非国有企业以及建设规模较大的区域更为显著。本研究为当前碳减排背景下中国绿色高质量发展战略提供了重要的理论依据。

abstract: We model the interaction between shareholder trading and voting on firm policies that create externalities for which investors have heterogenous preferences, and we test the model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，用以分析股东交易与投票在制定具有外部性的公司政策时的相互作用，其中投资者对这些外部性存在异质性偏好，并通过实验室实验检验了模型的均衡预测。模型表明（且实验结果证实）：低政策成本有利于政策采纳，而在中等成本条件下，分散偏好下的政策采纳率低于极化偏好。当政策被采纳时，观察到的股价高于均衡预测值，且接近未采纳政策时公司的基本面价值。我们得出结论：具有外部性的高成本政策对股东的负担可能低于理论预测。
title: Trade, Voting, and Firm Policies: Theory and Evidence

abstract: I examine the effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment by exploring a unique historical setting -- the postmaster occupation during the early twentieth-century United States. Unlike many occupations that established practices to prevent married women from entering, postmasters were open to married women and offered flexible work arrangements and equal pay. With a novel dataset on postmaster appointments and census linking, I show that postmasters attracted qualified women who were not gainfully employed previously. However, the postmaster occupation offered women few benefits beyond the appointed term. Taking advantage of the fact that postmasters were presidential appointees and were rarely re-appointed after the party of the president changed, I compare the 1940 outcomes of women appointed just before and after the 1933 presidential transition in a regression discontinuity (RD) design. The RD estimates suggest that women experienced a 26.7 percentage points reduction in gainful employment after finishing their postmaster term. The negative employment effect is unique to women and does not apply to men appointed under the same circumstances. In addition, I show that women postmasters were not more likely to be employed than their women neighbors who had never been postmasters, despite their work experience. The lack of benefits for women's future employment is in part explained by state-level discrimination against married women working and the severity of the Great Depression.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察20世纪初美国邮政局长这一独特的历史职业背景，探究了女性友好型职业对就业的影响。与许多通过制度性规定阻止已婚女性进入的职业不同，邮政局长职位对已婚女性开放，并提供灵活的工作安排与同工同酬。基于邮政局长任命记录与人口普查关联数据构建的新数据集，本研究发现：邮政局长职位吸引了此前未从事有酬工作的合格女性。然而，该职业除任期内的权益外，几乎未为女性提供长期职业发展优势。利用邮政局长由总统任命、且总统所属政党更迭后极少获得连任的制度特征，本文采用断点回归设计（RD），比较了1933年总统权力交接前后被任命的女性在1940年的就业状况。断点回归估计表明，女性在结束邮政局长任期后，有酬就业率下降26.7个百分点。这一负面就业效应仅存在于女性群体，在相同条件下任命的男性并未出现类似现象。此外，研究显示，尽管拥有工作经验，女性邮政局长与其从未担任该职位的女性邻居相比，就业概率并未更高。女性未来就业缺乏职业红利的部分原因，可归因于各州对已婚女性就业的歧视政策以及大萧条时期的严重经济冲击。
title: The effect of a woman-friendly occupation on employment: U.S. postmasters before World War II

abstract: This paper examines which country should undertake forest restoration when production and deforestation jointly degrade environmental absorption capacity. We develop a two-country dynamic game in which a forest owner derives revenues from deforestation while a non-owner benefits from production; both generate emissions, but only deforestation directly reduces carbon sink efficiency. Restoration is costly and subject to inertia. Consistent with international governance frameworks, the restoring country commits to a predetermined restoration path, while the non-restorer may either commit or retain strategic flexibility. Under homogeneous strategies, long-run environmental outcomes are independent of which country restores. Under heterogeneous strategies, however, the allocation of restoration responsibility becomes crucial: assigning restoration to the producer may aggravate environmental degradation and lead to history-dependent, potentially irreversible dynamics, whereas assigning it to the deforester mitigates opportunistic behavior and promotes more stable outcomes. A novel finding is that history-dependency is both control-specific and parameter-dependent: the deforester’s deforestation and restoration controls exhibit strong Skiba behavior robustly across parametric regimes, while the producer’s emissions exhibit weak Skiba behavior when economically dominant but become more sensitive to initial conditions when the deforester dominates. These results reflect an asymmetry in transmission channels and suggest that robust environmental protection requires aligning restoration responsibilities with forest ownership.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨当生产与毁林共同削弱环境吸收能力时，应由哪个国家承担森林恢复责任。我们构建了一个两国动态博弈模型：森林所有者通过毁林获取收益，而非所有者则从生产中获益；两者均产生排放，但只有毁林行为直接降低碳汇效率。森林恢复成本高昂且存在惯性。遵循国际治理框架，恢复国承诺执行既定恢复路径，而非恢复国可选择承诺或保留战略灵活性。在策略同质化情形下，长期环境结果与恢复责任归属无关。然而在策略异质化情形下，恢复责任的分配变得至关重要：将恢复责任分配给生产国可能加剧环境退化，并引发依赖历史路径且可能不可逆的动态过程；而将其分配给毁林国则可抑制机会主义行为，促进更稳定的结果。一项新发现表明：历史路径依赖性既具有控制特异性又具有参数依赖性——毁林国的毁林与恢复控制在不同参数区间均表现出显著的Skiba行为，而生产国的排放控制在经济主导时呈现弱Skiba行为，但在毁林国主导时对初始条件更为敏感。这些结果反映了传导渠道的非对称性，并表明稳健的环境保护需要将恢复责任与森林所有权相匹配。

title: Restoration Responsibility in a Dynamic Game of Deforestation, Production, and Pollution Accumulation

abstract: Small open economies often anchor their exchange rate to a basket of foreign currencies, with weights typically set from trade shares or financial exposure. Such schemes ignore the heterogeneity of pass-through across currencies and the covariance structure of bilateral rates, and therefore do not minimize the volatility of imported inflation, the central bank’s mandate. This paper proposes a minimum-variance framework — formally analogous to a Markowitz portfolio problem in pass-through space — in which basket weights minimize the variance of exchange-rate-driven imported inflation, subject to a constraint that preserves the basket’s cumulative pass-through. Applied to the case of Fiji, an import-intensive island economy with a five-currency basket, the optimization reduces the variance of imported inflation by close to twenty percent, with results robust across alternative specifications.
abstract_zh: 小型开放经济体通常将本币汇率与一篮子外币挂钩，权重通常根据贸易份额或金融敞口设定。此类方案忽略了汇率传导在不同货币间的异质性以及双边汇率的协方差结构，因此无法最小化进口通胀的波动性——而这正是央行的政策目标。本文提出一个最小方差框架——在形式上类似于汇率传导空间中的马科维茨投资组合问题——在该框架下，一篮子货币的权重在保持篮子累积汇率传导效应的约束条件下，最小化汇率驱动的进口通胀方差。将该方法应用于斐济这一进口密集型岛国（其采用五货币篮子）的案例后，优化方案使进口通胀方差降低近20%，且结果在不同设定下均保持稳健。
title: Optimal Currency Basket Estimation
title_zh: 最优货币篮子估计

abstract: As global change accelerates, Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) programs have become increasingly important tools for addressing the interconnected challenges of land degradation, biodiversity loss, water scarcity, and climate change. PES programs provide incentives to individuals or communities, conditional on people adopting sustainable natural resource management practices to support or increase ecosystem service provisioning. Although conditionality is considered a “PES-defining feature,” little is known about how conditionality is perceived by community members and how such perceptions influence their participation in and experience with PES programs. To address this gap, we conducted an extensive qualitative study of Watershared, a Bolivian PES program, to investigate (1) how community members perceive conditionality in PES and its two components—monitoring and sanction, and (2) how removing conditionality influences PES participants’ perceptions of the program and relationship with the implementing organization. We found that Watershared participants perceived monitoring as more than just a compliance check mechanism; they saw it as a form of technical support and relationship building, which strengthens their relational values toward both nature and the program itself. Participants were generally unconcerned about sanctioning, with many viewing sanctioning as unnecessary or unenforceable, despite the implementing organization having imposed sanctions previously. Watershared participants with unconditional contracts generally noticed the removal of conditionality, with some interpreting it as a lack of care and reciprocity from the implementing organization. These results highlight how relational values were developed and supported through the two components of conditionality in PES. These results suggest that the role of conditionality in PES may be less about surveillance and penalty to ensure conservation, but more about serving as an avenue to activate and strengthen community members’ relational values toward nature and the PES-implementing organization, which may, in turn, improve program effectiveness and future participation. In the face of intensifying global environmental change, such relational values tied to conditionality in PES, as identified in this research, are critical for fostering and sustaining cooperation, trust, and long-term commitment to conservation.
abstract_zh: 随着全球变化加速，生态系统服务付费（PES）项目已成为应对土地退化、生物多样性丧失、水资源短缺和气候变化等相互关联挑战的重要工具。PES项目向个人或社区提供激励，条件是他们采取可持续自然资源管理实践，以支持或增加生态系统服务供给。尽管条件性被视为“PES的定义性特征”，但关于社区成员如何感知条件性，以及这种感知如何影响他们参与PES项目并形成相关体验，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对玻利维亚的Watershared PES项目进行了广泛的定性研究，旨在探究：（1）社区成员如何感知PES中的条件性及其两个组成部分——监测与制裁；（2）取消条件性如何影响PES参与者对项目的看法及其与实施组织的关系。我们发现，Watershared参与者将监测视为不仅仅是合规检查机制，更将其视为一种技术支持和关系建设形式，这强化了他们对自然和项目本身的关联价值。参与者普遍不关心制裁，许多人认为制裁不必要或无法执行，尽管实施组织此前曾施加过制裁。拥有无条件合同的Watershared参与者通常注意到条件性的取消，其中一些人将其解读为实施组织缺乏关怀和互惠。这些结果凸显了关联价值如何通过PES条件性的两个组成部分得以发展和支持。这些结果表明，PES中条件性的作用可能不在于通过监督和惩罚来确保保护，而更多是作为激活和加强社区成员对自然及PES实施组织的关联价值的途径，这进而可能提升项目有效性和未来参与度。面对日益加剧的全球环境变化，本研究所识别的与PES条件性相关的关联价值，对于培养和维持合作、信任以及对保护的长期承诺至关重要。
title: The unexpected role of conditionality in shaping relational values: Insights from an incentive-based conservation program in Bolivia
title_zh: 条件性在塑造关系价值中的意外作用：来自玻利维亚激励型保护项目的证据

abstract: This paper examines how tokenization and distributed ledger technology may transform Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) by enabling smart contracts to perform a growing share of functions traditionally undertaken by central securities depositories, central counterparties, and trade repositories. It argues that while record-keeping, settlement, collateral management, and reporting can increasingly be executed on-chain, key functions requiring legal certainty, governance, accountability, and discretion remain institutional in nature. The analysis assesses which activities across issuance, clearing, settlement, and reporting can migrate to code, where limitations persist, and how risks evolve in tokenized environments. It finds that tokenization is more likely to reconfigure than eliminate FMIs, creating new efficiencies while introducing novel operational and governance risks. The most plausible outcome is a hybrid FMI model in which technology and institutions jointly provide the trust, resilience, and oversight required for financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨代币化与分布式账本技术如何通过使智能合约承担中央证券存管机构、中央对手方及交易数据库等传统金融基础设施（FMIs）中日益增多的职能，从而推动其变革。研究指出，尽管记录保存、结算、抵押品管理及报告等环节可逐步迁移至链上执行，但涉及法律确定性、治理、问责及自由裁量权的关键职能仍具有制度属性。本文系统评估了发行、清算、结算及报告等环节中哪些活动可迁移至代码执行、现存局限性所在，以及代币化环境下风险演变特征。研究发现，代币化更可能重构而非消除金融基础设施，在创造新效率的同时引入新型操作与治理风险。最可能的结果是形成混合型金融基础设施模式——技术与机构共同提供金融稳定所需的信任、韧性及监管能力。
authors: Yaiza Cabedo & Mr. Tommaso Mancini-Griffoli & Fabian Schär & Nicolas Zhang
title: Financial Market Infrastructures Evolution in a Tokenized Economy
title_zh: 代币化经济中金融市场基础设施的演进

abstract: Exploiting cohort and spatial variation in exposure to India’s Universal Immunization Program (UIP), I estimate the program’s effects on child mortality and educational attainment. The results show that UIP exposure reduced infant mortality by 0.4 percentage points and under-five mortality by 0.5 percentage points. While the program clearly improved child survival, its effects on educational outcomes were mixed, reflecting changes in the composition of surviving children. UIP exposure reduced primary school completion but increased secondary school completion. The negative effect at lower levels of schooling may reflect lower average health among marginal surviving children or a quantity–quality trade-off arising from unanticipated improvements in child survival. In contrast, the positive effect on secondary schooling may reflect improved health and human capital among children further from the margin of survival.
abstract_zh: 利用印度全民免疫计划（UIP）覆盖率的队列与空间差异，本文评估了该计划对儿童死亡率及教育成就的影响。结果显示，UIP覆盖使婴儿死亡率降低0.4个百分点，五岁以下儿童死亡率降低0.5个百分点。尽管该计划显著改善了儿童存活率，但对教育成果的影响呈现分化特征，这反映了存活儿童群体构成的变化。UIP覆盖降低了小学完成率，但提高了中学完成率。较低教育阶段的负面效应可能源于边际存活儿童的平均健康水平下降，或儿童存活率意外提升引发的数量-质量权衡。相比之下，中学教育阶段的正面效应则可能反映了远离存活临界点的儿童健康水平与人力资本的改善。
title: The effects of childhood immunization programs on health and education: micro-evidence from India
title_zh: 儿童免疫规划对健康和教育的影响：来自印度的微观证据

abstract: Unlike the universal child allowances available in many advanced democracies, the largest child-specific income benefit in the United States, the Child Tax Credit (CTC), is a function of tax liabilities and earnings. As a result, it disproportionately reaches middle- and high-income families and leaves many low-income families ineligible. This study examines, from its enactment through present day, how legislative changes to the federal Child Tax Credit’s key parameters—including refundability, the earnings requirement, and the maximum credit amount—have impacted the share of children eligible for the full credit (overall and by subgroup), and how full-credit eligibility relates to the credit’s impact on child poverty and bottom-tail income inequality, including whether these three metrics move in tandem. We find that, in all years except 2021, at least 19% of children—and often, substantially more—were ineligible for the full CTC because their families had low or moderate incomes. The sizeable variation in full-credit ineligibility across years resulted from legislative changes that widened and narrowed eligibility over time. Furthermore, the credit’s impact on child poverty and income inequality does not always move in the same direction, depending on the type of policy change. Reforms that increased the credit value without substantial expansions to refundability left more children ineligible for the full credit and increased income inequality. By contrast, refundability expansions broadened full-credit eligibility while reducing poverty and inequality. Impacts on child poverty and inequality were greatest when full refundability was paired with higher credit amounts.
abstract_zh: 与许多发达民主国家普遍提供的儿童津贴不同，美国最大的专项儿童收入补助——儿童税收抵免（CTC）——取决于纳税义务和劳动收入。因此，该政策不成比例地惠及中高收入家庭，而许多低收入家庭则不具备资格。本研究考察了自该政策实施至今，联邦儿童税收抵免关键参数（包括可退还性、收入要求及最高抵免额度）的立法调整如何影响符合全额抵免资格的儿童比例（总体及分群体），以及全额抵免资格与该政策对儿童贫困和底层收入不平等的影响之间的关系，包括这三项指标是否同步变化。我们发现，除2021年外，所有年份中至少19%的儿童（且通常比例更高）因家庭收入较低或中等而无法获得全额CTC。不同年份间全额抵免资格的巨大差异源于立法调整随时间推移扩大或缩小了资格范围。此外，该政策对儿童贫困和收入不平等的影响并非总朝同一方向变化，具体取决于政策调整的类型。提高抵免额度但未大幅扩大可退还性的改革，导致更多儿童无法获得全额抵免，并加剧了收入不平等。相比之下，扩大可退还性则拓宽了全额抵免资格，同时减少了贫困和不平等。当全额可退还性与更高抵免额度相结合时，对儿童贫困和不平等的影响最为显著。
title: How the U.S. child tax credit has benefited children over time: historical trends in eligibility, poverty, and income inequality
title_zh: 美国儿童税收抵免如何长期惠及儿童：资格、贫困与收入不平等的历史趋势

abstract: We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.

abstract: Some rural counties remain dependent on agricultural or manufacturing jobs, but an increasing proportion have diversified economics. Rural counties also differ in their abilities to commute to an urban market characterized by higher wages and labor productivity. National changes in immigration and trade policies have had heterogeneous effects on rural labor markets, with counties dependent on agriculture or food processing facing rising input costs and shrinking international output markets. Increased commuting will help some rural communities adapt, while more remote counties will face outmigration, population loss, and reduced capacity to sustain public services.

abstract: Cocoa production forms the backbone of West Africa's agricultural economy, sustaining smallholder farmers whose livelihoods depend on stable yields. Critical to these yields is the provision of pollination services by a few key species, notably, the minuscule Forcipomyia spp. While many studies have modeled the effects of complete pollinator collapse, the impacts of gradual declines remain little studied. In this study, we develop an integrated ecological–economic model that links pollinator abundance with cocoa yield, incorporating the global cocoa market and an economy‐wide framework for Ghana, one of the world's major cocoa producers. We examine scenarios in which declines in pollinator populations occur at regional, national, and supranational scales. Our analysis reveals that localized declines in pollinator populations detrimentally affect cocoa farmers and Ghana's national economy, with rural communities and low‐income households bearing a disproportionate share of the welfare losses. In contrast, widespread declines across West Africa trigger a “King effect” where rising global cocoa prices partially mitigate production losses, benefiting farmers while overall consumer surplus declines. These results highlight the necessity of conserving pollinator biodiversity to safeguard cocoa production and economic welfare at multiple scales.
abstract_zh: 摘要 可可生产是西非农业经济的支柱，支撑着依赖稳定产量维持生计的小农户。而关键传粉物种（尤其是微小的蠓属昆虫）提供的传粉服务对产量至关重要。尽管已有大量研究模拟了传粉者完全崩溃的影响，但传粉者逐渐减少的后果仍鲜有探讨。本研究构建了一个整合生态-经济模型，将传粉者丰度与可可产量相关联，并纳入全球可可市场及世界主要可可生产国加纳的整体经济框架。我们模拟了传粉者种群在区域、国家及超国家尺度上衰退的情景。分析表明：局部传粉者种群衰退对可可农户及加纳国民经济造成不利影响，其中农村社区和低收入家庭承受了不成比例的福利损失；而西非全境的广泛衰退则触发"国王效应"——全球可可价格上涨部分抵消了产量损失，使农户受益，但消费者剩余整体下降。这些结果凸显了保护传粉者生物多样性对保障多尺度可可生产与经济福利的必要性。

abstract: This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种基于Neyman（1937）思想的倾向得分平滑设定检验。我们推导出倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。通过密度加权方法，将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性检验。我们提出一种新颖的投影方法，以消除估计未知冗余参数时产生的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准分布，并对以参数速率收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡渐近功效，其中为样本容量。为增强方法的实际适用性，我们进一步引入数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，实现基于观测数据的自动选择。与现有方法相比，本检验避免了Shaikh等（2009）面临的“维度灾难”；同时，相较于Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法，本检验既具有渐近枢轴性，又具有更高的计算效率。大量模拟表明，所提检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往检验相比，本检验在整体表现上相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频备择假设）展现出明显改进。两项实证应用进一步验证了本方法的实际适用性，分别检验了苏联156工程和美国职业团计划中的倾向得分设定。
title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score

abstract: If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less-attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses–and therefore who ultimately bears the cost-depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.
abstract_zh: 摘要 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来买单？我们利用挪威工会会费税收抵扣政策的变化作为企业层面工会密度的准外生变动来源，对企业在工会化程度提高时的应对措施进行了全面评估。在私营企业平均层面，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，导致企业收缩就业与生产规模，在降低利润的同时并未提升劳动收入份额。成本负担由多方共同承担：消费者通过更高价格承担部分成本，股东通过更低利润承担部分成本，其余部分则被生产率提升所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失集中于依附性较弱的“局外人”工人。企业应对措施随市场竞争程度呈现系统性差异。在制造业中，由于企业面临竞争程度较低的产品与劳动力市场，其应对模式截然相反：平均而言企业会扩大就业与生产规模，降低劳动力市场议价能力，且未出现利润下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本主要通过提价转嫁给消费者，其余部分被生产率提升所抵消。工人因工资与就业同步增长而受益。这些模式表明，工会能够抵消雇主的买方垄断势力，而企业应对措施——以及最终的成本承担者——在很大程度上取决于市场结构。总体而言，该情境下的工会化主要实现从消费者向工人的再分配而非从股东向工人的再分配，且对不同企业产生显著差异化的影响，包括资源向规模更大、生产率更高的企业重新配置。我们通过一个包含产品市场与劳动力市场势力的工会谈判局部均衡模型对这些模式进行了理论解释。

abstract: This paper utilizes wealth shocks from winning lottery prizes to examine the causal effect of financial resources on fertility. We employ extensive panels of administrative data encompassing over 0.4 million lottery winners in Taiwan and implement a triple-differences design. Our analyses reveal that a substantial lottery win can significantly increase fertility, the implied wealth elasticity of which is around 0.06. Moreover, the primary channel through which fertility increases is by prompting first births among previously childless individuals. Finally, our analysis reveals that approximately 25% of the total fertility effect stems from increased marriage rates following a lottery win.

abstract: This study examines the causal effect of P M 2.5 air pollution exposure on premature mortality in Southern European cities from 2010 to 2018. We leverage local variations in precipitation and wind speed as a source of random variation in P M 2.5 exposure. Using the Two-Sample Two-Stage Least Squares (TS2SLS) estimator to reconcile monitoring station-level and city-level data, our findings reveal a statistically significant increase in premature mortality caused by P M 2.5 . According to our preferred specification, a 1% increase in P M 2.5 causes a 0.82% rise in the under-65 mortality rate and a 0.93% rise in the infant mortality rate. The results are robust to alternative specifications. The most affected populations are those residing in urban areas (relative to suburban areas) and those living in cities located in richer regions (as opposed to poorer ones). We also examine the role of additional pollutants, finding further evidence for the importance of particulate matter.

abstract: Public-health interventions often aspire to generate spillovers beyond the households they directly reach, but identifying who is exposed to whom within communities is challenging. Researchers frequently approximate social exposure using geographic proximity, even though the individuals who transmit health advice need not be nearby. We study this issue by conducting secondary analysis of a randomized maternal and child health counseling intervention in rural Honduras with geocoded households and mapped social networks. At our main 50-meter radius, geographic proximity captures only 30.8% of health-advice ties, while only 3.7% of geographically proximate household pairs are connected by advice-giving. The choice of exposure mapping matters for what the analysis detects. Exposure mappings based solely on geographic proximity yield a precise zero effect on diarrhea knowledge. By contrast, exposure through advice ties beyond 50 meters increases diarrhea knowledge, and the effect is statistically distinguishable from exposure through nearby non-advice contacts. The evidence suggests that simple, actionable illness-management knowledge diffuses through advice relationships that geographic proximity alone fails to capture. Reported diarrhea, indicating whether the respondent or any child had diarrhea in the previous four weeks, also increases with advice exposure outside 50m, consistent with greater recognition, recall, or reporting rather than higher underlying morbidity. We find no corresponding effects for respiratory knowledge or reported respiratory illness. Our results show that using geographic proximity as a proxy for social exposure can mask important channels of information transmission and could lead researchers to miss meaningful spillover effects.
abstract_zh: 公共卫生干预措施往往期望在直接覆盖的家庭之外产生溢出效应，但识别社区内谁与谁接触具有挑战性。研究人员常以地理邻近性近似衡量社会接触，尽管传播健康建议的个体未必相邻。我们通过对洪都拉斯农村地区一项随机母婴健康咨询干预进行二次分析来研究这一问题，该干预包含地理编码家庭和映射社会网络数据。在主要50米半径范围内，地理邻近性仅捕捉到30.8%的健康建议联系，而仅有3.7%的地理邻近家庭对存在建议传递关系。暴露映射的选择会影响分析结果。仅基于地理邻近性的暴露映射显示对腹泻知识的影响精确为零。相反，通过50米外建议联系产生的暴露能提升腹泻知识，其效应在统计上显著区别于邻近非建议接触的暴露。证据表明，简单可行的疾病管理知识通过建议关系传播，而单纯地理邻近性无法捕捉这种关系。报告腹泻（反映受访者或任何儿童在过去四周内是否出现腹泻）也随50米外建议暴露增加而增加，这与更高的认知、回忆或报告率一致，而非潜在发病率上升。我们未发现呼吸系统知识或报告呼吸系统疾病存在相应效应。研究结果表明，将地理邻近性作为社会接触的代理变量可能掩盖重要的信息传播渠道，并导致研究者遗漏有意义的溢出效应。

abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.

abstract: The stochastic block model (SBM) has been widely used to analyze network data. Various goodness-of-fit tests have been proposed to assess the adequacy of model structures. To the best of our knowledge, however, none of the existing approaches are applicable for sparse networks in which the connection probability of any two communities is of order log(n)/n, and the number of communities is divergent. To fill this gap, we propose a novel goodness-of-fit test for the stochastic block model. The key idea is to construct statistics by sampling the maximum entry-deviations of the adjacency matrix that the negative impacts of network sparsity are alleviated by the sampling process. We demonstrate theoretically that the proposed test statistic converges to the Type-I extreme value distribution under the null hypothesis regardless of the network structure. Accordingly, it can be applied to both dense and sparse networks. In addition, we obtain the asymptotic power against alternatives. Moreover, we introduce a bootstrap-corrected test statistic to improve the finite sample performance, recommend an augmented test statistic to increase the power, and extend the proposed test to the degree-corrected SBM. Simulation studies and two empirical examples with both dense and sparse networks indicate that the proposed method performs well.
title: A goodness-of-fit test for sparse networks

abstract: Variations in the low- and high-frequency components of temperature may have distinct impacts on economic outcomes. Parametric and non-parametric estimates from three panels of data all find significant heterogeneity in the relative importance of the two components, but there is clear evidence in each panel of a common, slowly evolving low-frequency factor that is highly correlated with the low-frequency factor of economic activity. In regressions that quantify the output effects of the components, we find that one-way clustered standard errors often lead to size distortions, and that an additive fixed effect specification does not adequately control for common time effects. Using bootstrap inference to assess estimates from our preferred interactive fixed effect specification, we only find a marginally significant effect of the high-frequency component on growth in the U.S. panel. However, the effect of the low-frequency component is significant in the European and International panels, suggesting that the increase in the low-frequency temperature component over the post-1980 period is associated with a reduction in economic growth of approximately 1.3 percentage points. The findings are corroborated by time series estimation using data at the unit and national levels.

abstract: This study makes a significant contribution to the expanding body of literature on the energy-growth nexus, distinguishing itself in two important ways. First, this is the first meta-analysis that systematically compares the economic growth impacts of renewable versus nonrenewable energy sources, instead of relying on aggregate energy indicators. Second, it explicitly explores the heterogeneity of these effects in the context of developing countries. These elasticities exhibit notable nonlinearity, following a U-shaped pattern across stages of development. In low-income countries, the relatively higher elasticity for both energy types likely reflects the critical need to expand access, regardless of the source. As countries move up the income ladder, the elasticity of renewables tends to decline, potentially reflecting short-term frictions and adjustments associated with the integration of intermittent sources, and comes to a plateau for high-income countries. In contrast, fossil fuels may remain essential in higher-income contexts for supporting grid stability and storage as renewable energy becomes more integrated. The findings underscore the need for customized energy policies that correspond to each country's economic development stage. In low-income countries, policies should focus on expanding access to affordable and reliable energy sources. In developed economies, policies should aim to encourage innovations in clean energy technologies and support technology transfer to developing countries, assisting them in sustainably meeting their energy requirements for economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本研究对能源与经济增长关系的文献体系做出了重要贡献，其独特性体现在两个方面。首先，这是首项系统比较可再生能源与不可再生能源对经济增长影响的元分析研究，而非依赖总体能源指标。其次，本研究明确探讨了发展中国家情境下这些影响的异质性特征。这些弹性系数呈现显著的非线性特征，在经济发展阶段中呈U型分布。在低收入国家，两种能源类型均表现出相对较高的弹性，这很可能反映了无论能源来源如何，扩大能源可及性的迫切需求。随着国家收入水平提升，可再生能源弹性趋于下降，这或许反映了间歇性能源整合过程中的短期摩擦与调整，并在高收入国家趋于平稳。相比之下，在可再生能源整合程度加深的背景下，化石燃料在高收入经济体中对维持电网稳定性和储能仍具关键作用。研究结果强调，能源政策需根据各国经济发展阶段进行定制化设计。在低收入国家，政策应聚焦于扩大可负担且可靠能源的可及性；在发达经济体，政策应着力于激励清洁能源技术创新，并支持向发展中国家进行技术转移，协助其以可持续方式满足经济增长所需的能源需求。

abstract: Sovereigns self-insure via reserve accumulation, prioritizing liquidity over yield. This practice imposes opportunity costs and can amplify the convenience premium on traditional reserve assets. This paper evaluates Synthetic Reserve Deposits (SRDs), a pooling mechanism designed to improve the return-liquidity trade-off. Participants would hold floating-value claims on a vehicle comprising a settlement buffer, an investment portfolio, and, in some designs, an optional collateralized liquidity window. The architecture separates the allocation of portfolio risk from the provision of short-term foreign-currency liquidity: market risk remains with SRD holders, while liquidity is provided through redemption at contemporaneous executable value or through secured advances. Simulations illustrate that the structure can shift the return-liquidity frontier outward under explicit downside-risk constraints. General equilibrium modeling suggests that, if implemented at sufficient scale and under appropriate conditions, reallocating reserve demand through this mechanism could increase the effective supply of reserve claims and affect the global financial cycle, creating aggregate welfare gains and possibly Pareto improvements depending on initial global asset positions.
abstract_zh: 主权国家通过积累外汇储备进行自我保险，优先考虑流动性而非收益。这种做法会产生机会成本，并可能放大传统储备资产的便利溢价。本文评估了合成储备存款（SRDs）这一旨在改善收益-流动性权衡的集合机制。参与者将持有对某一工具的可变价值债权，该工具包含结算缓冲池、投资组合，以及在某些设计中增设的可选抵押流动性窗口。该架构将组合风险配置与短期外币流动性供给相分离：市场风险由SRD持有者承担，流动性则通过按当前可执行价值赎回或通过担保垫款提供。模拟分析表明，在明确的下行风险约束下，该结构可将收益-流动性边界向外推移。一般均衡模型显示，若在适当条件下以足够规模实施，通过该机制重新配置储备需求可增加储备债权的有效供给，影响全球金融周期，产生总体福利收益，并可能根据初始全球资产头寸实现帕累托改进。

abstract: This paper examines macrofinancial linkages between property developers, financial institutions, and macroeconomic outcomes in China. Using a parsimonious vector autoregressive (VAR) model enabled by a machine learning algorithm, it quantifies how idiosyncratic shocks can propagate and be amplified across sectors, with potential implications for financial stability. Stress originating from privately owned developers and regionally focused financial institutions—though relatively limited in scale—can generate persistent spillovers through lending relationships, common exposures, shared markets, and changes in market sentiment. A decline in property prices may undermine investment, weaken consumer confidence, and adversely affect the health of both the property and financial sectors, thereby disrupting financial intermediation and weighing on broader economic growth. Policy considerations should take into account these feedback loops. Market- and exposure-based tools can be helpful for monitoring macrofinancial linkages and assessing the transmission of shocks.

abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。

abstract: After decades in the making, Brazil’s landmark VAT reform was approved in 2023. The primary objective of the reform is to eliminate distortions and reduce the complexity of the current consumption tax system while maintaining revenue neutrality. In addition, specific design features were included to alleviate the VAT’s inherent regressivity and improve the equity of the Brazilian tax system. This paper assesses the reform’s expected equity print leveraging a microstatic model based on household data and simulates policy options to further improve distributional outcomes. While the new VAT achieves a fairly equal distribution of the tax burden across most income groups, the poorest still carry a heavier load in terms of their disposable income. Dissecting the impact by policy instrument, the reform’s approved reduced rates aggravate regressivity, while zero rates and the new cashback lower the tax burden for poorer households, under the revenue neutrality assumption. Overall, the combined use of these measures dampens the reform’s equity outcomes somewhat as a higher VAT reference rate is required on all other items to maintain revenue neutrality. The paper also shows that some equity improvements stem from the reform’s implied pivot towards taxing services. Finally, simulations show that focusing on and expanding the cashback could amplify equity gains by raising the poorest disposable income by 25 percent via reductions in their tax liability.
abstract_zh: 历经数十年酝酿，巴西里程碑式的增值税改革于2023年获批。此次改革的首要目标是在保持税收中性前提下，消除现行消费税体系的扭曲效应并降低其复杂性。此外，改革还纳入了特定设计特征，以缓解增值税固有的累退性，提升巴西税收体系的公平性。本文基于家庭数据的微观静态模型评估了改革预期的公平性影响，并模拟了进一步改善分配结果的备选政策方案。尽管新增值税制在多数收入群体间实现了较为均衡的税负分配，但最贫困群体在可支配收入层面仍承担着更重的负担。按政策工具分解影响可见：在税收中性假设下，改革批准的优惠税率加剧了累退性，而零税率与新推行的现金返还机制则降低了贫困家庭的税负。总体而言，这些措施的联合使用在一定程度上削弱了改革的公平性效果——为维持税收中性，所有其他商品需适用更高的增值税基准税率。本文还表明，部分公平性改善源于改革隐含的服务业征税重心转移。最后，模拟结果显示，聚焦并扩大现金返还机制可通过减少贫困群体税负使其可支配收入提升25%，从而放大公平性收益。
authors: Ana Cebreiro Gomez & Ms. Christina Kolerus
title: Brazil's VAT Reform: Improving Equity
title_zh: 巴西增值税改革：提升公平性

abstract: Exchange rate movements have implications for the purchasing power of residents or voters. Given that the exchange rate is often seen as a barometer of government performance, there could be strong incentives to influence exchange rate valuation during elections. This paper investigates whether political economy factors affect Foreign Exchange Intervention (FXI) policy across countries. It investigates whether central banks tend to implement FX sales, leaning against depreciations, during electoral periods in a sample of 28 countries including both advanced (AEs) and emerging (EMs) economies over the period 2000-2019. The results show that EMs with competitive elections tend to implement more and larger FX sales in pre-electoral period, compared to post-election period, given their political popularity. Further, this result is driven by countries where political pressures on central bank governors are more prevalent. Furthermore, the paper also finds that monetary policy transparency has the potential to mitigate this politically driven FXI during electoral period. Finally, the paper discusses policy implications given that politically motivated FX sales could hamper the ability of central banks to effectively respond to large shocks.
abstract_zh: 汇率变动对居民或选民的购买力具有重要影响。鉴于汇率常被视为政府绩效的晴雨表，选举期间可能存在强烈动机干预汇率估值。本文研究政治经济因素是否会影响各国的外汇干预政策，基于2000-2019年涵盖28个经济体（包括发达经济体和新兴经济体）的样本，考察央行是否倾向于在选举期间实施外汇抛售以应对本币贬值压力。结果表明，具有竞争性选举的新兴经济体在选举前阶段，出于政治声望考量，会实施更多且规模更大的外汇抛售。进一步分析显示，这一结果在央行行长面临更普遍政治压力的国家尤为显著。此外，本文还发现货币政策透明度具有缓解选举期间政治驱动型外汇干预的潜力。最后，本文讨论了政策启示：出于政治动机的外汇抛售可能削弱央行有效应对重大冲击的能力。
title: The Political Economy of Foreign Exchange Interventions
title_zh: 外汇干预的政治经济学

abstract: I study how the production network shapes monetary policy transmission to prices. Using U.S. data, I show that industries farther upstream from final demand exhibit larger cumulative price responses to monetary shocks, while downstream industries absorb shocks through output. A calibrated multi-sector New Keynesian model rationalizes these patterns: upstream sectors, which sell predominantly to other firms, reprice more frequently and therefore exhibit less price rigidity. A counterfactual decomposition of the price response shows that this heterogeneity in price rigidity---rather than cost-cascade propagation through input-output linkages---is the primary driver of the cross-sectional responses. The upstreamness differential is strongly asymmetric, large following expansionary shocks but nearly absent following contractionary ones, consistent with asymmetric price rigidity compounding across production stages. abstract_zh: 本文研究生产网络如何塑造货币政策向价格的传导机制。基于美国数据，我发现距离最终需求越远的上游行业，其价格对货币冲击的累积响应幅度越大，而下游行业则通过产出吸收冲击。一个经过校准的多部门新凯恩斯模型解释了这一模式：上游行业主要向其他企业销售产品，其调价频率更高，因此价格刚性更弱。对价格响应的反事实分解表明，这种价格刚性的异质性——而非通过投入产出链的成本级联传导——是行业间价格响应差异的主要驱动因素。上游度差异呈现显著非对称性：在扩张性冲击后效应显著，而在紧缩性冲击后几乎消失，这与价格刚性在生产阶段间叠加放大的非对称特征一致。综合来看，这些发现表明货币政策
title: Production Networks and the (Asymmetric) Transmission of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 生产网络与货币政策的（非对称）传导

abstract: The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)
abstract_zh: 循证政策的实施依赖于向政策制定者传播证据，这一过程受到信息发送方特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验，由意识形态对立的智库、主流报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传达一项非意识形态、具有成本效益的政策。结果显示，当信息传递机构与政策制定者意识形态一致时，政策采纳率提高了65%。我们比较了智库与媒体在政策实施中的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相当。我们探讨了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL分类号：C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）
title: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
title_zh: 意识形态一致性对循证政策采纳的影响

abstract: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中央银行可信度对长期通胀及通胀动态的影响。我们将中央银行缺乏承诺的特征引入标准非线性新凯恩斯经济模型（该模型包含粘性价格与垄断竞争企业）。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境的相互作用共同驱动。研究表明，当劳动楔子出现未预期的永久性上升或品种间替代弹性下降时，长期通胀水平将随之上升。在过渡阶段，通胀会出现超调现象，随后逐步回落。从量化角度看，通胀超调具有持续性，且相较于通胀目标制，缺乏承诺导致的福利损失较为显著。（JEL分类号：D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58）
title: Monetary Policy without Commitment
title_zh: 无承诺的货币政策

abstract: We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了96项与气候相关的税收和支出政策的福利影响。我们对公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架进行了扩展和应用，尤其提出了一种纳入干中学溢出效应的新方法。研究发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。针对电网污染严重地区的节能引导政策具有较高的MVPF。燃油税和总量控制与交易政策是高效的财政收入手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估算，并比较了这些估算所提供的政策启示。（JEL分类号：D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）
title: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
title_zh: 气候变化政策的福利分析

abstract: I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业市场势力与工人议价能力如何影响工资与福利。基于法国微观数据，我记录了现有模型无法解释的工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式。一个涵盖企业生产垂直差异化产品并与工人分享利润的模型能够解释这些模式。该模型：（i）揭示了估算买方垄断势力与议价能力面临的新挑战，并提出替代性方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导效应取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成率如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化论证了增强工人议价能力对工资与福利的影响。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）
title: Understanding High-Wage Firms: Monopoly, Monopsony, and Bargaining Power
title_zh: 理解高工资企业：垄断、买方垄断与议价能力

abstract: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)
abstract_zh: 学龄前儿童易患疾病，并会将疾病传染给其他家庭成员。尽管这一经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的程度和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑正在发育的婴儿同胞而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据发现，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病的住院率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序与学龄前儿童呼吸系统疾病患病率的市内差异，发现早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的收入、教育程度、慢性呼吸系统健康及心理健康相关结果产生了持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）
title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread
title_zh: 家庭中的病菌：家庭内部疾病传播的短期与长期后果

abstract: We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)
abstract_zh: 我们利用企业层面数据证明，私营企业的利润份额存在大幅波动。这种波动源于产出的大规模、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而这些变化并未完全伴随投入要素的同步调整。我们通过一个企业家动态模型来解释这一现象。由于企业可以通过缩小经营规模来限制风险敞口，我们的模型预测，不可保的商业风险将导致巨大的宏观经济损失，其规模远超信贷约束所造成的损失。尽管自我融资使企业家能够迅速克服信贷约束，但即使是富裕的企业家仍面临显著的风险敞口。（JEL分类号：D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）
title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
title_zh: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本

abstract: We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)
abstract_zh: 我们证明，根据遗漏变量影响的衡量方式不同，遗漏变量翻转系数符号的难度可能远低于将其归零的难度。这一现象出现在广泛使用的稳健性指标“奥斯特德尔塔”（Oster 2019a）中。因此，每当该指标数值较大（表明遗漏变量可能不重要）时，一个更小的数值即可逆转目标参数的符号。我们提出了一种修正的稳健性度量方法以解决这一问题。我们通过四个实证应用和两项元分析展示了研究结果，并在配套的Stata模块“regsensitivity”中实现了相关方法。（JEL C18, C21, C52）
title: The Effect of Omitted Variables on the Sign of Regression Coefficients
title_zh: 遗漏变量对回归系数符号的影响

abstract: What is the optimal response of a resource exporter when a price cap is imposed on its main export? This paper develops a dynamic framework incorporating stochastic prices, financial frictions, and market power to study this novel tool of statecraft. With the right design, a price cap can incentivize increased extraction, stabilizing prices in the global market. But the stabilizing effects diminish when there is leakage outside the cap. Consequently, weak enforcement of the policy worsens the trade-off faced by the sanctioning policymaker. We provide a systematic approach to setting and enforcing an optimal cap level in these circumstances. (JEL F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35)
abstract_zh: 当资源出口国的主要出口产品被施加价格上限时，其最优应对策略是什么？本文构建了一个融合随机价格、金融摩擦与市场势力的动态分析框架，以研究这一新型国家治理工具。若设计得当，价格上限可激励出口国扩大开采规模，从而稳定全球市场价格。但当存在超出价格上限范围的漏出效应时，这种稳定作用将减弱。因此，制裁政策制定者面临的政策执行力度不足问题，会加剧其面临的权衡困境。我们针对此类情形，提出了一套设定并执行最优价格上限水平的系统性方法。（JEL分类号：F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35）
title: A Theory of Price Caps on Nonrenewable Resources
title_zh: 非可再生资源价格上限理论

abstract: We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)
abstract_zh: 本文证明，在具有反周期风险特征的异质性主体新凯恩斯（HANK）经济体中，自然利率具有内生性并与产出协同变动，导致经济易受自我实现波动的影响。与代表性主体新凯恩斯模型不同，若风险仅呈现轻微反周期特征，泰勒原理不足以确保HANK经济中均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化的反应强度如何，均存在多重有界均衡。要使积极的货币政策消除自我实现波动，必须稳定内生性自然利率波动。此外，被动的货币政策与积极的财政政策组合亦可消除均衡多重性。（JEL分类号：E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）
title: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
title_zh: HANK经济中的自我实现波动

abstract: Technological lock-in has been a standard explanation for the slow take-off of clean innovation, but is hard to reconcile with forward-looking investors who anticipate the eventual switch to clean technologies. We provide an alternative explanation: strategic investment complementarities shape innovation and self-fulfilling prophecies can lead to delayed low-carbon transition. We analyze a standard directed technical change model with clean and dirty inputs. Under good input substitutability, two stable steady states co-exist, each allowing multiple transitional paths. Optimal low-carbon transition requires a Pigouvian tax rule combined with a coordination device; commitment to a Pigouvian tax trajectory cannot solve a coordination failure. (JEL H23, O31, O33, O44, Q54, Q55)
abstract_zh: 技术锁定一直是解释清洁创新起步缓慢的标准理论，但这一观点难以与预期最终将转向清洁技术的具有前瞻性的投资者相协调。我们提出另一种解释：战略性投资互补性塑造了创新过程，而自我实现的预言可能导致低碳转型延迟。我们分析了一个包含清洁与污染投入的标准定向技术变革模型。在投入品替代性良好的条件下，两个稳定稳态并存，每个稳态均允许多条转型路径。最优低碳转型需要将庇古税规则与协调机制相结合；而承诺实施庇古税轨迹无法解决协调失灵问题。(JEL H23, O31, O33, O44, Q54, Q55)
title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies in the Transition to Clean Technology
title_zh: 清洁技术转型中的自我实现预言

abstract: This paper develops a framework in which university research depends endogenously on competition for tuition and talented students in the market for higher education. When students are highly stratified across colleges, or when tuition rises sharply with school rank, universities spend on R&D even if the direct contribution of research to teaching is small. The model is consistent with causal evidence and matches new features of the microdata. It explains why universities internally fund research with tuition, despite negligible returns to patenting. Calibrated simulations suggest that existing tuition policies boost university research while research subsidies crowd it out. (JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，其中大学研究内生于高等教育市场中争夺学费与优秀学生的竞争。当学生高度分层于不同院校，或学费随学校排名急剧上升时，即使研究对教学的直接贡献微乎其微，大学仍会投入研发。该模型与因果证据一致，并匹配了微观数据的新特征。它解释了为何大学会利用学费内部资助研究，尽管专利化回报微不足道。校准模拟表明，现行学费政策促进了大学研究，而研究补贴反而产生了挤出效应。（JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34）
title: University Research and the Market for Higher Education
title_zh: 大学研究与高等教育市场

abstract: This paper examines the behavior of individuals susceptible to a deadly disease in a tractable equilibrium setting. We analytically characterize individually optimal mitigation behavior and the resulting equilibrium trajectory. Analysis is facilitated by a phase diagram. A key insight is that individually optimal behavior of those susceptible to the disease results in excessive caution. This behavior flattens the epidemic curve and prolongs the epidemic. In contrast, socially optimal behavior results in a higher infection rate, with a focus on minimizing cumulative deaths at minimum cost. The paper offers novel technical contributions and an improved understanding of externalities in econ-epi models. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)
abstract_zh: 本文在一个易于处理的均衡框架下，研究了易感致命疾病个体的行为。我们通过解析方法刻画了个体最优的缓解行为及其导致的均衡轨迹，并借助相图进行分析。核心发现是：易感个体的最优行为会导致过度谨慎，这种平缓了流行病曲线，却延长了疫情持续时间。相比之下，社会最优行为会带来更高的感染率，其核心目标是以最小成本最小化累计死亡人数。本文在技术层面提出创新，并深化了对经济-流行病模型中外部性的理解。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）
title: An Analytical Model of Behavior and Policy in an Epidemic
title_zh: 流行病中行为与政策的分析模型

abstract: Using county-level and zip-code-level data from the United States during the period 1998–2018, we document: (i) Increased flood risk has a large negative impact on firm entry, employment, and output in the long run; (ii) Flood events reduce output in the short run while impact on firm entry and employment is limited. We then develop a quantitative spatial model to characterize how flood risk shapes firms’ location choices and employment. We find flood risk reduced US aggregate output by 0.53 percent in 2018, 23 percent of which stemmed from direct damages and 77 percent from long-run adjustments of firms and workers. (JEL D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32)
abstract_zh: 利用1998–2018年间美国县级和邮政编码级数据，我们得出以下发现：（i）长期来看，洪水风险的增加对企业进入、就业和产出产生显著的负面影响；（ii）短期来看，洪水事件会降低产出，但对企业进入和就业的影响有限。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间模型，用以刻画洪水风险如何影响企业的区位选择和就业。研究发现，2018年洪水风险使美国总产出下降了0.53%，其中23%源于直接损失，77%源于企业与工人的长期调整。（JEL分类号：D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32）
title: Expecting Floods: Firm Entry, Employment, and Aggregate Implications
title_zh: 预期洪水：企业进入、就业与总体影响

abstract: We propose a text-based measure of monetary policy stance that models FOMC statements as convex combinations of dovish and hawkish alternatives, providing a tractable representation of the Committee's position along the policy spectrum. Leveraging staff-drafted alternative statements, we fine-tune a pretrained language model to capture both quantitative precision and semantic tone. Stance is defined as the product of tone and novelty, and decomposed into expected and surprise components using high-frequency financial data. Surprises arise from shifts in tone relative to expectations or from statement novelty. Our framework enables counterfactuals showing how alternative communication could have moved markets. (JEL D83, D84, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58)
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于文本的货币政策立场衡量方法，将联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）声明建模为鸽派与鹰派选项的凸组合，从而为委员会在政策谱系中的立场提供可处理的表征。利用工作人员起草的备选声明，我们对预训练语言模型进行微调，以同时捕捉量化精确性与语义基调。立场被定义为基调与新颖性的乘积，并借助高频金融数据分解为预期成分与意外成分。意外成分源于相对于预期的基调变化或声明的新颖性。我们的框架能够实现反事实分析，展示替代性沟通方式如何影响市场走势。（JEL分类号：D83, D84, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58）
title: Deciphering Federal Reserve Communication via Text Analysis of Alternative FOMC Statements
title_zh: 通过替代性FOMC声明的文本分析解读美联储沟通

abstract: In trade models with scale economies, import liberalization reduces exports within industries by shrinking real market potential. We find this export destruction mechanism reduced US export growth following the permanent normalization of trade relations with China (PNTR). There was also an offsetting boost to exports from lower input costs. We use our estimates to calibrate a quantitative model and show that scale economies are economically important for trade policy analysis. Although PNTR increased aggregate US exports relative to GDP, exports declined in the most exposed industries. US gains from PNTR are positive but 30 percent smaller than under constant returns. (JEL D24, E23, F13, F14, O19, P33)
abstract_zh: 在具有规模经济的贸易模型中，进口自由化通过缩小实际市场潜力减少了行业内的出口。我们发现，这一出口破坏机制降低了美国在与中国建立永久正常贸易关系（PNTR）后的出口增长。同时，较低的投入成本对出口产生了抵消性的提振作用。我们利用估计结果校准了一个量化模型，并表明规模经济对贸易政策分析具有重要的经济意义。尽管PNTR增加了美国相对于GDP的总出口，但在受影响最大的行业中，出口却有所下降。美国从PNTR中获得的收益为正，但比在规模报酬不变条件下低30%。（JEL D24, E23, F13, F14, O19, P33）
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Import Liberalization as Export Destruction? Evidence from the United States
title_zh: 进口自由化是出口破坏吗？来自美国的证据

abstract: Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with US data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80)
abstract_zh: 如果具有异质性技能的工人自我选择进入不同部门，服务业劳动生产率增长可能被误测。基于美国数据，本文发现：从制造业重新配置到专业服务业的工人，其收入高于该部门原有工人，但低于教育、卫生和公共服务部门的原有工人。一个广义定量罗伊模型预测，专业服务业中由选择效应导致的劳动生产率增长，比传统选择模型的预测值高出10个百分点。总体而言，选择效应对服务业成本病的贡献微乎其微，这与文献中的假设形成鲜明对比。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80）
title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
title_zh: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病

abstract: This paper studies the dispersion and cyclicality of TFPR. Recent business cycle models assume countercyclical dispersion in TFPQ based on evidence of countercyclical dispersion in TFPR, though TFPR reflects endogenous prices. An overlapping generations model with monopolistic competition and state-dependent pricing is constructed to match three key data patterns: (i) countercyclical dispersion of TFPR, (ii) countercyclical dispersion of price changes, and (iii) countercyclical frequency of price adjustment. These patterns are matched either if shocks to the dispersion of TFPQ are negatively correlated with the mean of TFPQ, or if the monetary authority responds to them by “leaning against the wind.” (JEL D24, E23, E24, E32, E51, E52)
abstract_zh: 本文研究TFPR的离散性与周期性。近期商业周期模型基于TFPR反周期离散的证据假设TFPQ存在反周期离散，但TFPR反映的是内生价格。本文构建了一个包含垄断竞争和状态依存定价的代际交叠模型，以匹配三个关键数据特征：（i）TFPR的反周期离散性，（ii）价格变动的反周期离散性，以及（iii）价格调整频率的反周期性。这些特征得以匹配的条件是：要么TFPQ离散性的冲击与TFPQ均值呈负相关，要么货币当局通过“逆风干预”对此类冲击做出响应。（JEL分类号：D24, E23, E24, E32, E51, E52）
title: TFPR: Dispersion and Cyclicality
title_zh: TFPR：离散性与周期性

abstract: This paper studies the sectoral and macroeconomic consequences of carbon taxes in four Nordic countries using a novel monthly measure of effective carbon tax rates. The suggested measure accounts for the time-varying emission coverage of taxes that are both explicitly and implicitly levied on greenhouse gas-emitting goods, thereby solving several issues of existing carbon tax measures currently used by the literature. Employing the new measure in a local projection setting, I find that carbon taxes reduce emissions as expected but also impair macroeconomic activity—though there is some heterogeneity in the effects across sectors and countries. (JEL H23, O44, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本文利用一种新颖的月度有效碳税率指标，研究了四个北欧国家碳税的部门及宏观经济影响。该指标考虑了针对温室气体排放商品征收的显性和隐性税收的时变排放覆盖率，从而解决了现有文献中碳税指标存在的若干问题。在局部投影框架下应用这一新指标，我发现碳税虽如预期般减少了排放，但也削弱了宏观经济活动——尽管不同部门和国家的效应存在一定异质性。（JEL分类号：H23, O44, Q54, Q58）
title: The Economic Consequences of Effective Carbon Taxes
title_zh: 有效碳税的经济后果

abstract: Employment protections often create two-tiered labor markets with substantial differences in job security. I estimate the effects of removing these protections using a quantitative life cycle model, where younger workers are more likely to select into precarious jobs. Workers accumulate human capital when employed and face the possibility of human capital losses in unemployment. Because workers with greater job security experience fewer unemployment spells, they tend to accumulate more human capital over their careers. I show that reducing employment protections boosts younger workers’ job-finding rates but lowers human capital, GDP, and employment. Impacts of these policies differ significantly by age. (JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)
abstract_zh: 就业保护往往导致劳动力市场出现两级分化，不同岗位的工作保障程度差异显著。本文通过构建量化生命周期模型，评估了取消这些保护措施的经济效应。在该模型中，年轻劳动者更倾向于选择不稳定的工作岗位。劳动者在就业期间积累人力资本，而失业则面临人力资本贬损的风险。由于工作保障程度较高的劳动者经历失业的次数更少，其职业生涯中积累的人力资本往往更多。研究表明：降低就业保护虽能提升年轻劳动者的就业率，但会降低人力资本存量、国内生产总值及整体就业水平。这些政策对不同年龄段劳动者的影响存在显著差异。（JEL分类号：D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42）
title: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
title_zh: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响

abstract: We explore how foreign central banks behave when firms engage in currency mismatch, borrowing heavily in dollars. A central bank can deal with risky private-sector mismatch in two ways: (i) with financial regulation or (ii) by accumulating reserves to better serve as a dollar lender of last resort. We highlight a novel externality: Individual central banks may overaccumulate dollar reserves, as this exacerbates a global scarcity of dollar-denominated assets, lowering dollar interest rates and encouraging firms to further increase their currency mismatch. Relative to the decentralized outcome, a global planner may prefer tighter financial regulation and reduced holdings of dollar reserves. (JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28)
abstract_zh: 本文探讨当企业存在货币错配、大量借入美元时，外国中央银行的行为模式。央行应对私营部门风险性货币错配有两种方式：（i）实施金融监管，或（ii）积累外汇储备以更好地充当美元最后贷款人。我们揭示了一种新颖的外部性：单个央行可能过度积累美元储备，因为这会加剧全球美元计价资产的稀缺性，压低美元利率，并鼓励企业进一步扩大其货币错配。相较于分散化决策的结果，全球规划者可能更倾向于实施更严格的金融监管并减少美元储备持有量。（JEL分类号：E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28）
title: Central Banks as Dollar Lenders of Last Resort: Implications for Regulation and Reserve Holdings
title_zh: 中央银行作为美元最后贷款人：对监管与储备持有的影响

abstract: Using a new survey, we document high dispersion of marginal revenue products across firms in the European Union. To interpret this dispersion, we develop a highly portable framework to quantify gains from better allocation of resources. We demonstrate that apart from direct measures of distortions, firm characteristics, such as demographics, quality of inputs, utilization of resources, and dynamic adjustment of inputs, are predictors of the marginal revenue products of capital and labor. We emphasize that some firm characteristics may reflect compensating differentials rather than constraints and the effect of constraints on the dispersion of marginal products may be smaller. (JEL D22, D24, D25, E23, G31, L25)
abstract_zh: 基于一项新调查，我们记录了欧盟企业内部边际收益产品的高度离散性。为解释这一离散现象，我们构建了一个高度可移植的框架，用以量化资源优化配置带来的收益。研究表明，除直接衡量扭曲程度的指标外，企业特征（如人口统计特征、投入品质量、资源利用率及投入的动态调整）均可预测资本与劳动的边际收益产品。我们强调，部分企业特征可能反映补偿性差异而非约束条件，且约束条件对边际产品离散性的影响可能较小。（JEL分类号：D22, D24, D25, E23, G31, L25）
title: Resource Misallocation in European Firms: The Role of Constraints, Firm Characteristics, and Managerial Decisions
title_zh: 欧洲企业资源错配：约束、企业特征与管理决策的作用

abstract: Little is known about the evolution and persistence of the effects of one-time cash transfers, especially in rural agricultural settings with limited productive investment opportunities. We use bimonthly phone surveys to estimate dynamic impacts for cash transfer recipients in Liberia and Malawi. We find immediate increases in food security that attenuate over time but do not entirely dissipate even 1.5–2 years later, driven by increased farm investments and production. We find increases in farm profits, reductions in casual off-farm labor, improvements in psychological well-being, and, in Liberia, a reduction in intimate partner violence (IPV). (JEL I31, I32, J43, O12, O13, Q12)
abstract_zh: 关于一次性现金转移效应的演变与持续性，尤其是在农村农业环境中有限的生产性投资机会下，我们知之甚少。我们利用双月电话调查，估算利比里亚和马拉维现金转移接受者的动态影响。研究发现，粮食安全立即改善，但随时间推移逐渐减弱，即使在1.5至2年后也未完全消失，这主要源于农业投资和生产的增加。我们还观察到农业利润上升、非农临时劳动减少、心理健康改善，以及在利比里亚，亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）减少。（JEL I31, I32, J43, O12, O13, Q12）
title: The Dynamic Effects of Cash Transfers to Agricultural Households
title_zh: 现金转移对农业家庭动态效应

abstract: Firms often exploit weaknesses in government contracts to boost revenues, yet little is known about how they allocate these funds. We study how hospitals allocated $3 billion obtained from gaming a Medicare loophole. The average gaming hospital increased Medicare and total revenue by around 10 percent, implying large spillovers on other payers. Nonprofit hospitals deployed most funds toward operating costs. For-profits—driven by a large chain—deducted funds off their balance sheets, distributing them to executives and shareholders. Accordingly, we detect reductions in mortality only at nonprofits. Our results imply that the consequences of engineered windfalls vary substantially by hospital ownership. (JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31)
abstract_zh: 企业常利用政府合同漏洞增加收入，但关于这些资金如何分配的研究甚少。本文研究了医院如何分配通过利用医疗保险制度漏洞获得的30亿美元。平均而言，利用漏洞的医院将医疗保险收入和总收入提高了约10%，这意味着对其他支付方产生了巨大的溢出效应。非营利性医院将大部分资金用于运营成本。营利性医院——由大型连锁医院驱动——则将资金从资产负债表中扣除，分配给高管和股东。相应地，我们仅在非营利性医院中观察到死亡率下降。研究结果表明，意外收益的后果因医院所有权性质而显著不同。（JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31）
title: Turbocharging Profits? Contract Gaming and Revenue Allocation in Healthcare
title_zh: 涡轮增压利润？医疗保健中的合同博弈与收入分配

abstract: We evaluate a nationwide zero-cost intervention to reduce teacher sorting, where lower-income students are more likely to attend understaffed schools with less qualified teachers. Our approach was grounded in an insight from behavioral economics known as order effects. In the treatment arm, the teacher job application platform showed hard-to-staff schools first, while, in the control group, schools were displayed alphabetically. Treated teachers were more likely to apply to hard-to-staff schools, ranking them their highest priority. Inattentive or less qualified teachers did not influence the results. The intervention helped to reduce the unequal distribution of qualified teachers across schools. (JEL D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15)
abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项全国性的零成本干预措施，旨在减少教师分配不均问题——低收入家庭学生更可能就读于师资短缺、教师资质较差的学校。该干预措施基于行为经济学中的“顺序效应”洞见。在实验组中，教师求职平台优先展示师资紧缺学校，而对照组则按字母顺序排列学校。受干预的教师更倾向于申请师资紧缺学校，并将其列为最高优先级。注意力不集中或资质较差的教师并未影响结果。该干预措施有助于缩小合格教师在学校间的不均衡分布。（JEL分类号：D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15）
title: Order Effects and Teacher Labor Supply: A Nationwide RCT in Ecuador
title_zh: 顺序效应与教师劳动力供给：厄瓜多尔的一项全国性随机对照试验

abstract: US firms hiring foreign workers in low-skill nonfarm jobs face a binding quota on the “H-2B” visa, allocated in part through a randomized lottery. We evaluate the quota’s marginal impact using the lottery, a novel firm survey, and a pre-analysis plan. Firms exogenously employing more H-2B workers in low-skill jobs increase production (elasticity 0.20–0.22), investment (1.5–2.1), and profits (0.15). The elasticity of substitution between H-2B and US workers is very low (0.8–2.2). Thus, the effect on US employment is zero or positive overall, and positive in rural areas. Forensic analysis suggests similarly low substitutability of black-market labor. (JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37)
abstract_zh: 美国企业在低技能非农岗位雇佣外籍工人时，面临“H-2B”签证的约束性配额，该配额部分通过随机抽签分配。我们利用抽签机制、一项新颖的企业调查以及预分析计划，评估了该配额的边际影响。在低技能岗位中因外生因素雇佣更多H-2B工人的企业，其产量（弹性0.20–0.22）、投资（1.5–2.1）和利润（0.15）均有所提升。H-2B工人与美国工人之间的替代弹性极低（0.8–2.2）。因此，该配额对美国就业的整体影响为零或为正，且在乡村地区呈现正向效应。法证分析表明，黑市劳动力的可替代性同样较低。（JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37）
title: The Effect of Low-Skill Immigration Restrictions on US Firms and Workers: Evidence from a Randomized Lottery
title_zh: 低技能移民限制对美国企业与工人的影响：来自随机抽签的证据

abstract: We conduct a large-scale field experiment in the Swedish pension system to examine to what extent information and search frictions explain dominated high-fee index fund choices. Three findings stand out: (i) Letters that increase awareness of a dominated choice and reduce search costs of finding the dominating alternative improve savers’ investment choices. (ii) While the average effects are positive, a majority of investors are unresponsive to information that essentially removes search costs. The inertia holds across expected gains, rejecting models with fixed adjustment costs. (iii) Lack of awareness and search costs account for at most 45 percent of dominated choices. (JEL C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32)
abstract_zh: 我们在瑞典养老金系统中开展了一项大规模实地实验，以探究信息和搜索摩擦在多大程度上解释了被高费率指数基金主导的劣质选择。三个主要发现如下：（i）提高对劣质选择认知度并降低寻找更优替代方案搜索成本的函件，改善了储蓄者的投资选择。（ii）尽管平均效应为正，但大多数投资者对实质上消除了搜索成本的信息无动于衷。这种惯性在预期收益范围内普遍存在，从而否定了固定调整成本模型。（iii）认知缺失和搜索成本最多只能解释45%的劣质选择。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32）
title: Dominated Pension Investments: The Role of Search Frictions and Unawareness
title_zh: 受支配的养老金投资：搜索摩擦与认知缺失的作用

abstract: Changes in political boundaries aimed at devolving power to local governments are common across many countries. We examine the economic impacts of government unit creation through splitting. Exploiting reforms that led to sharp increases in the number of municipalities in Brazil, we show that voluntary splitting enlarges the public sector, enhances public service delivery, and stimulates long-term economic activity in new local governments. These gains are not offset by losses elsewhere and are stronger in peripheral, remote, and underdeveloped areas neglected by parent governments. Higher fiscal revenues and decentralized decision-making contribute to the positive effects on local economic activity. (JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, H77, Q53, R51)
abstract_zh: 旨在将权力下放至地方政府而进行的政治边界调整在许多国家都很常见。本文通过分析政府单位拆分创建的影响，考察其经济效应。利用导致巴西城市数量急剧增加的改革，我们发现自愿拆分扩大了公共部门规模，提升了公共服务供给，并刺激了新地方政府长期的经济活动。这些收益并未被其他地区的损失所抵消，且在那些被原属政府忽视的边缘、偏远及欠发达地区更为显著。更高的财政收入与分散化决策对地方经济活动的积极效应起到了推动作用。（JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, H77, Q53, R51）
title: Decentralizing Development: The Economic Impacts of Government Splits
title_zh: 分散化发展：政府分裂的经济影响

abstract: We study the link between regional capitals and urban development. We exploit new global data on hundreds of first-order administrative and capital city reforms from 1987 until 2018 to estimate the capital city premium. Gaining capital status increases city growth in the medium term, spilling over to nearby cities. The capital premium varies with the size of the territory governed by the city, and political status complements favorable economic fundamentals. We document two mechanisms: migration of educated individuals to capital cities and heightened public and private investment, with private investment favoring capital cities with stronger economic fundamentals. (JEL D72, E22, H54, O18, R11, R12, R58)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了区域首府与城市发展之间的联系。利用1987年至2018年间全球数百个一级行政区和首府城市改革的新数据，我们估算了首府城市溢价。获得首府地位会在中期内促进城市增长，并产生溢出效应，惠及邻近城市。首府溢价因城市所辖领土规模而异，且政治地位与有利的经济基本面形成互补。我们记录了两个机制：受过教育的个体向首府城市迁移，以及公共和私人投资的增加，其中私人投资更倾向于经济基本面较强的首府城市。（JEL D72, E22, H54, O18, R11, R12, R58）
title: The Political Geography of Cities
title_zh: 城市政治地理学

abstract: Received wisdom holds that income rank matters for life satisfaction, but causal evidence on the nature and impact of income comparisons is limited. We randomize individuals from a representative sample of mid-career Finns to receive personal rank information from one of several reference groups. We find strong evidence of the effect of rank information on income satisfaction, but weaker effects on life satisfaction, and some evidence of real effects in experimental and administrative data. Effects are strong in narrow reference groups and weak and insignificant in the national one. Finally, we discuss the implications for income transparency policies. (JEL D31, D63, D83, D91, I31)
abstract_zh: 普遍观点认为，收入排名对生活满意度至关重要，但关于收入比较的性质及其影响的因果证据仍然有限。我们随机选取芬兰职业生涯中期人群的代表性样本，向其提供来自多个参照组之一的个人排名信息。研究发现，排名信息对收入满意度具有显著影响，但对生活满意度的影响较弱；实验数据与行政数据均显示存在部分实际效应。该效应在狭窄参照组中表现强烈，而在全国性参照组中则微弱且不显著。最后，我们探讨了该发现对收入透明度政策的启示。（JEL分类号：D31, D63, D83, D91, I31）
title: Which Reference Groups Matter and How? A Relative Income Information Experiment with Administrative Data
title_zh: 哪些参照群体重要以及如何重要？基于行政数据的相对收入信息实验

abstract: We analyze welfare under reference-dependent preferences. We decompose the first-order welfare effects of reference point and price changes into direct and behavioral effects. The sign of these effects depends on the form of reference-dependent payoffs; which effects are welfare relevant depends on whether reference dependence reflects a bias. We characterize corresponding social welfare effects in terms of estimable reduced-form parameters and normative judgments. We apply our framework to reference dependence in German workers’ retirement decisions. We find positive welfare effects of local increases in the normal retirement age (NRA) but ambiguous effects of financial incentives to postpone retirement. (JEL D91, H55, J26, J32)
abstract_zh: 我们分析了参照依赖偏好下的福利效应。将参照点与价格变化的一阶福利效应分解为直接效应和行为效应。这些效应的符号取决于参照依赖收益的具体形式；而哪些效应具有福利相关性则取决于参照依赖是否反映了某种偏差。我们通过可估计的简化形式参数和规范性判断来刻画相应的社会福利效应。将分析框架应用于德国工人退休决策中的参照依赖现象，研究发现：当地正常退休年龄（NRA）的提高带来正向福利效应，但延迟退休的财务激励措施产生的福利效应则具有不确定性。（JEL分类号：D91, H55, J26, J32）
title: The Welfare Economics of Reference Dependence
title_zh: 参考依赖的福利经济学

abstract: We examine the effect of intergroup competition on within-group violent conflict in Indonesia. Using a triple-differences design, we find that higher competition for national government transfers between villages reduces within-village conflict. These effects persist regardless of the competition’s outcome, are stronger in ethnically fractionalized and segregated villages, and are accompanied by higher attendance in village meetings. Our results are consistent with external competition favoring participation and cooperation within otherwise divided communities, suggesting that economic incentives to compete with out-groups combined with forms of civic engagement can be important mechanisms to reduce violence within communities. (JEL D74, H70, O15, O17, O18, Z13)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了群体间竞争对印度尼西亚群体内部暴力冲突的影响。采用三重差分设计，我们发现村庄间对中央政府转移支付的更高竞争减少了村庄内部冲突。无论竞争结果如何，这些效应均持续存在，在种族分化且隔离的村庄中更为显著，并且伴随着村庄会议出席率的提高。我们的结果与外部竞争促进原本分裂社区内的参与和合作这一观点一致，表明与外群体竞争的经济激励结合公民参与形式，可能是减少社区内部暴力的重要机制。（JEL D74, H70, O15, O17, O18, Z13）
title: Fostering Cooperation: The Conflict-Reducing Effects of Intervillage Competition for Government Transfers
title_zh: 促进合作：村际竞争政府转移支付的冲突缓解效应
